# Executive Summary

Behavioral, clinical, educational, and medical researchers frequently hold rich
unstructured text corpora---therapy progress notes, ecological momentary
assessment (EMA) journals, patient narratives, and student essays---governed by
Institutional Review Board (IRB), HIPAA, or FERPA protocols that strictly
prohibit transmitting participant text to external cloud LLM APIs.

**`airgapllm`** (v0.4.0) provides an auditable, privacy-first R workbench for
**verifiably offline local LLM inference** across `Ollama`, `llama.cpp`, and
`vLLM`. Every stage enforces defense-in-depth:

1. **Fail-Closed Network Isolation**: Canonical loopback / Unix-socket URL
   validation (blocking SSRF, IPv6-mapped IPv4, octal/hex/decimal IPs, CRLF,
   and proxy exfiltration), digest-pinned `--network none` Docker and HPC
   Apptainer configurations, read-only root filesystems, and symlink-confined
   SHA-256 model weight verification.
2. **Pre-Inference De-Identification & HIPAA Safe Harbor**: Deterministic
   pure-R PII detection and redaction (including Unicode homoglyph / zero-width
   canonicalization, ReDoS-safe regexes, HIPAA Safe Harbor ages > 89, and
   5-digit / restricted 3-digit US ZIP prefixes) plus keyed reversible
   pseudonymization stored in an encrypted RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-CBC +
   constant-time Encrypt-then-MAC (`0600`) local vault with atomic key rotation.
3. **Resumable Schema-Enforced Batch Extraction**: Strictly typed output
   tibbles, delimited `<UNTRUSTED_RESEARCH_RECORD>` prompt-injection framing,
   post-inference output PII leakage scanning, bounded structured repair
   retries, long-transcript overlapping chunking, and UTF-8-resilient atomic
   per-row JSONL checkpointing.
4. **Immutable Audit Trail & IRB Protocol Generation**: Tamper-evident
   SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL compliance logs (strictly barring raw text and
   PII), automated Markdown/Quarto IRB Methods boilerplate, and SHA-256-sealed
   compliance packets.

# Architecture & Threat Mitigations

| Threat Class | Primary Failure Mode | `airgapllm` Mitigation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Network Exfiltration / SSRF | Cloud API URLs, IPv6-mapped IPv4, octal IPs, outbound proxies | `is_loopback_endpoint()`, `preflight_isolation_check(strict_proxy = TRUE)`, `noproxy = "*"`, `--network none` |
| Supply-Chain & Weight Tampering | Mutable `:latest` tags, tampered GGUF shards, symlink escapes | Pinned `sha256:` image digests, `verify_model_digest(allow_symlinks = FALSE)` |
| Container Escape / Persistence | Writable rootfs, root capabilities, `:rw` bind injection | `--read-only`, `--cap-drop ALL`, `no-new-privileges`, strict path/env/arg validators |
| Pre-Inference PII Exposure | Direct PHI/PII or Unicode homoglyphs entering LLM context | Mandatory `pii_policy`, Unicode canonicalizer, HIPAA Safe Harbor age > 89 & ZIP3 |
| Vault Compromise / Padding Oracle | Plaintext mapping CSVs, unsalted keys, timing side channels | Vault v2: HKDF-SHA256 key separation, fresh salt/IV, AAD, constant-time MAC before decrypt, `0600` |
| Prompt Injection & Output Echo | Embedded instructions echoing PII into generated text | `<UNTRUSTED_RESEARCH_RECORD>` framing + `output_pii_action` post-inference scan |
| Mid-Batch Crash / Schema Drift | Walltime preemption, truncated UTF-8 writes, mixed schemas | Atomic JSONL checkpointing, trailing-crash recovery, schema + prompt hash guards |
| Post-Hoc Audit Tampering | Altered compliance logs or raw text leaking into logs | SHA-256 chain from `GENESIS`, constant-time verification, strict zero-PII schema allowlist |

# Practical End-to-End Compliance Workflow

All examples below execute 100% offline using the bundled `synthetic_notes`
dataset and deterministic `runtime_mock()`.

```{r end-to-end}
library(airgapllm)
data("synthetic_notes", package = "airgapllm")

# 1. Pre-inference privacy dry-run (strictly zero raw PII emitted)
dry_run <- pii_audit_dataframe(
  synthetic_notes,
  text_col = "note_text",
  id_col = "note_id"
)
dry_run
```

## GPU Sizing & Air-Gapped Container Generation

Before provisioning a lab GPU workstation or Slurm GPU node, estimate VRAM
requirements across quantization levels and generate pinned air-gapped
container specifications:

```{r gpu-and-container}
estimate_vram_requirements(
  params_b = 8,
  quantization = "Q4_K_M",
  context_length = 8192L,
  batch_size = 2L
)

spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "ollama",
  image = "ollama/ollama",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("a", 64)),
  model_dir = "/srv/airgapllm/models",
  model_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("b", 64)),
  gpu = "nvidia",
  memory_limit = "24g",
  user = "1000:1000"
)
spec
```

## Schema-Enforced Extraction, Audit Verification & Compliance Packet

```{r extract-packet}
work_dir <- tempfile("airgap_guide_")
dir.create(work_dir)

schema <- extraction_schema(
  sentiment = schema_field("enum", values = c("positive", "neutral", "negative")),
  severity = schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 10L),
  crisis_flag = schema_field("logical"),
  name = "clinical_coding_v1"
)

audit_file <- file.path(work_dir, "audit_log.jsonl")
ck_file <- file.path(work_dir, "checkpoint.jsonl")

results <- airgap_extract(
  data = synthetic_notes[1:6, ],
  text_col = "note_text",
  schema = schema,
  runtime = runtime_mock(model = "llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M", seed = 2026L),
  id_col = "note_id",
  pii_policy = "redact",
  checkpoint_path = ck_file,
  audit_log_path = audit_file,
  container_spec = spec
)

results[, c("note_id", "sentiment", "severity", "crisis_flag", ".status")]
audit_log_verify(audit_file)

pkt_dir <- file.path(work_dir, "irb_packet")
pkt <- export_irb_compliance_packet(
  out_dir = pkt_dir,
  extraction = results,
  audit_log_path = audit_file,
  container_spec = spec,
  study_title = "Offline Clinical Narrative Extraction Study",
  protocol_id = "IRB-2026-0412",
  regulatory_framework = c("HIPAA", "IRB")
)
pkt
```

# Cryptographic Vault Lifecycle & Key Rotation

For longitudinal studies requiring deterministic cross-wave coreference, use
`pii_pseudonymize()` paired with periodic `pii_vault_rotate_key()` rotation:

```{r vault-lifecycle}
k1 <- pii_vault_key()
k2 <- pii_vault_key()
vf <- file.path(work_dir, "study.vault.json")

pse <- pii_pseudonymize(synthetic_notes$note_text[1:3], key = k1, vault_path = vf)
rot <- pii_vault_rotate_key(vf, old_key = k1, new_key = k2)
rot[c("old_key_fingerprint", "new_key_fingerprint", "n_tokens")]

# Verify lossless local re-identification under the rotated master key
identical(pii_reidentify(pse$text, vault = vf, key = k2), synthetic_notes$note_text[1:3])
```

# Multi-Pass Consensus, k-Anonymity & Hardware Sizing (v0.4.0)

Beyond single-pass extraction and direct-identifier scrubbing, `airgapllm`
v0.4.0 adds multi-pass self-consistency extraction, quasi-identifier
$k$-anonymity / $l$-diversity export checks, and hardware-aware local sizing
and benchmarking:

```{r v04-highlights}
# 1. Hardware-aware sizing & throughput pilot benchmark
recommend_runtime_config(vram_gb = 24, ram_gb = 64, n_docs = 5000L, avg_tokens = 1000L)
benchmark_local_runtime(runtime_mock(seed = 42L), schema, n_sample = 6L, corpus_size = 5000L)

# 2. Multi-pass consensus extraction across 3 deterministic seeds
cons <- airgap_extract_consensus(
  synthetic_notes[1:4, ],
  text_col = "note_text",
  schema = schema,
  runtime = runtime_mock(seed = 100L),
  n_passes = 3L,
  id_col = "note_id"
)
consensus_diagnostics(cons)

# 3. Quasi-identifier k-anonymity & l-diversity export gate
export_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  site = c(rep("North", 6), rep("South", 2), rep("West", 5)),
  wave = c(rep(1L, 6), rep(2L, 2), rep(1L, 5)),
  tier = c("low", "high", "low", "mid", "high", "low", "high", "high", "low", "mid", "high", "low", "mid")
)
apply_k_anonymity(export_tbl, c("site", "wave"), k_min = 5L,
                  strategy = "mask_rare", sensitive_col = "tier", l_min = 2L)
```

# Pre-Submission IRB Operational Checklist

1. **Pin Exact Digests**: Record SHA-256 digests for both container image and
   local GGUF/safetensors weights via `verify_model_digest()`.
2. **Verify Isolation**: Run `preflight_isolation_check(strict_proxy = TRUE)`
   and archive `preflight_attestation.json`.
3. **Run Privacy Dry-Run**: Review `pii_audit_dataframe()` advisories and add
   study-specific clinic/program names to `pii_config(custom_dictionary = ...)`.
4. **Separate Vault Storage**: Keep encrypted `airgapllm_vault_v2` files and
   master keys on institutional encrypted storage separate from extracted
   datasets and audit logs; rotate keys via `pii_vault_rotate_key()`.
5. **Seal & Archive Packet**: Generate a verified compliance directory with
   `export_irb_compliance_packet()` and attach `irb_protocol_narrative.md` (or
   `.qmd`) to the IRB protocol submission.

```{r cleanup, include = FALSE}
unlink(work_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```
